Predicates:
LanguageGenerationTask(x) ::: x is a language generation task.
LanguageUnderstandingTask(x) ::: x is a language understanding task.
OutputIsTextSequence(x) ::: the output of x is a text sequence.
NLPTask(x) ::: x is a natural language processing task.
MachineTranslation(x) ::: x is machine translation.
Premises:
∀x (NLPTask(x) → (OutputIsTextSequence(x) → LanguageGenerationTask(x))) ::: If the output of a natural language processing task is a text sequence, then it is a language generation task.
MachineTranslation(x) ::: Machine translation is a natural language processing task.
OutputIsTextSequence(x) ::: The output of machine translation is a text sequence.
Conclusion:
MachineTranslation(x) → LanguageGenerationTask(x) ::: Machine translation is a language generation task.
